title: Trip manager rejects the options: don't move the morning leg
expected: The trip manager rejects the options because the client won't move the morning leg: revised options for the client, none of which move leg 1; leg 2 is not moved to 18:00.

email.subject: Re: Thursday — Bedford departure
email.body:
Hi again,

Sorry to do this — the meeting is now looking even later. Could we move the Bedford departure to 6pm instead?

Thanks so much,
Morgan

revision.previous_summary: Crew duty fails at 18:00 (14 h 13 min). Three options for the client: A) depart 17:45 with the same crew, $500; B) depart 18:00 and move A1-1 from 08:00 to 08:15, $1,000; C) depart 18:00 with Nandakumar/Kessler, who also fly P-1030, $3,000.
revision.instructions: The client won't move the morning leg. Only offer options that keep the TEB departure at 08:00.
